'''Elamposnia''' was a [[Monastery/Legends|monastery]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Elamposnia system/Legends|Elamposnia system]]. It was situated in the [[Back Reach]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Chenowei system/Legends|Chenowei system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Elamposnia was reserved for the elect of the [[Church of the Light]],<ref name="TEA" /> known as [[Recipients of the Light|Elamposnian monks]],<ref name="Planet" /> who took vows of chastity and poverty. In addition, communities that adhered to the religion occasionally sent their [[Recipients of the Light|members]] who had fallen into darkness to Elamposnia for penance.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Elamposnia was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-5.<ref name="TEA" />
